findings.highlight: the sunlight
findings.evidenceJa: 灰の陽射し
findings.governingReading: ashen sunlight
findings.explanation: The fire-linked gray cast over Illya’s death tableau disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t want a child dying in front of me
findings.evidenceJa: 子供が死ぬのはイヤだ
findings.governingReading: I cannot bear a child dying
findings.explanation: The English imports “in front of me” from the next, separate proposition.

findings.highlight: Why are these eyes crying?
findings.evidenceJa: 無関係な涙を流している
findings.governingReading: why are these eyes shedding tears for someone unrelated to me
findings.explanation: Shirou’s estrangement from his own grief and insistence that Illya is unrelated disappear.

findings.highlight: you’re something ‘special’ that you can’t put on the scale
findings.evidenceJa: そもそも自分っていうのは秤にかけられない[r]“別格”
findings.governingReading: the self is categorically outside anything that can be weighed
findings.explanation: Rin’s general principle that one’s self is the scale becomes a claim that Shirou personally is special.

findings.highlight: But you can’t do that
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎は自分があるじゃない
findings.governingReading: but you possess a self, Shirou
findings.explanation: Rin’s central claim that Shirou has a definite self disappears.

findings.highlight: You can’t pretend you are not living for yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 自分をないがしろにするなんて出来ない
findings.governingReading: you cannot continue neglecting your own self
findings.explanation: Self-neglect becomes alleged dishonesty about Shirou’s motives.

findings.highlight: you’re so screwed up
findings.evidenceJa: アンタがおかしくなってる
findings.governingReading: you have become abnormal
findings.explanation: Rin’s frightened diagnosis is given harsh modern slang.

findings.highlight: I’ll live a thankless life
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の行く末が報われない
findings.governingReading: the road ahead of me will never be rewarded
findings.explanation: A tragic, futile outcome becomes lack of gratitude from others.

findings.highlight: becausecorpses are something
findings.evidenceJa: 人の死は見慣れたもの
findings.governingReading: because human death is something
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses the causal conjunction and noun.

findings.highlight: You saw something gruesome ten years ago
findings.evidenceJa: それだけのモノを、十年前に見た
findings.governingReading: you saw death on that scale ten years ago
findings.explanation: Rin’s inference about magnitude is replaced with generic gore.

findings.highlight: Rider who got her neck twisted off
findings.evidenceJa: 変わり果てた姿で死んでいたライダー
findings.governingReading: Rider, dead and changed beyond recognition
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents a specific neck-breaking death.

findings.highlight: they’ve died a natural death
findings.evidenceJa: “人の死”を迎えている
findings.governingReading: their deaths still resemble “human death”
findings.explanation: Comparison to the fire’s inhuman devastation becomes a claim about natural causes.

findings.highlight: the main reason why Tohsaka is criticising me
findings.evidenceJa: 責められる要因
findings.governingReading: a factor for which Tohsaka could blame me
findings.explanation: The English invents a hierarchy by calling the fire the main reason.

findings.highlight: My body is telling me
findings.evidenceJa: 自分自身が訴えている
findings.governingReading: my own self protests
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-knowledge is reassigned specifically to his body.

findings.highlight: I had nothing to give
findings.evidenceJa: その時は、何もなかった筈だ
findings.governingReading: at that time, nothing of me should have remained
findings.explanation: Shirou’s existential emptiness becomes lack of payment in a transaction.

findings.highlight: I do not have any regrets
findings.evidenceJa: 道に懺悔はなく
findings.governingReading: there was no repentance along that path
findings.explanation: The same stylized path statement is again flattened into ordinary regret.

findings.highlight: My self lost its self there
findings.evidenceJa: 我はそこで自身をなくした
findings.governingReading: there I lost my very self
findings.explanation: The repeated line again becomes malformed reflexive English.

findings.highlight: there’s no way my mind could have been saved
findings.evidenceJa: 心まで生き返る筈がない
findings.governingReading: there was no way my heart could come back to life as well
findings.explanation: Emotional resurrection becomes cognitive rescue.

findings.highlight: Ohthat’s… right
findings.evidenceJa: ああそう、だった
findings.governingReading: Ah—yes, that was it
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses Shirou’s recovering interjection.

findings.highlight: I didn’t even put it into my memory
findings.evidenceJa: そもそも記憶などしていなかった
findings.governingReading: I had never even retained it as a memory
findings.explanation: The English uses an unnatural, volitional storage metaphor.

findings.highlight: I only received
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はただ、貰っただけだ
findings.governingReading: I was only given something
findings.explanation: The English leaves the transitive verb without an object at the key contrast with loss.

findings.highlight: At that time, I thought
findings.evidenceJa: その淵で思った
findings.governingReading: there at the brink, I thought
findings.explanation: The near-death abyss framing Shirou’s revelation disappears.

findings.highlight: the first thing that came into my sight
findings.evidenceJa: 目にしたその姿
findings.governingReading: the figure I witnessed
findings.explanation: The English invents priority and turns Kiritsugu’s image into an unspecified thing.

findings.highlight: Sothat’s all the emotion I could create
findings.evidenceJa: だから俺は、そんな感情しか作れなかった
findings.governingReading: and so that was the only emotion I could create
findings.explanation: A missing space breaks the conclusion of Shirou’s self-diagnosis.

findings.highlight: take full advantage of your good fortune
findings.evidenceJa: その幸運を噛みしめなさい
findings.governingReading: savor that good fortune
findings.explanation: Rin urges gratitude for survival; the English turns it into instrumental exploitation.

findings.highlight: I wanted to be a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になりたくて
findings.governingReading: I wanted to become an ally of justice
findings.explanation: The central ideal is again replaced by a pop-culture category.

findings.highlight: seriously angry for my sake
findings.evidenceJa: 他人である俺の為に、本気で怒ってくれている
findings.governingReading: earnestly angry for the sake of me, someone other than herself
findings.explanation: The other-directed nature of Rin’s concern—the answer to Shirou’s problem—loses its explicit force.

findings.highlight: She sighs
findings.evidenceJa: 大きく肩で息をして
findings.governingReading: breathing heavily with her shoulders heaving
findings.explanation: Rin’s visible agitation becomes a quiet sigh.
